title: The Gull-Dart and the Orchard Pledge

bible.title: The Gull-Dart and the Orchard Pledge
bible.kernel: Kolfinna hires mercenaries to fetch a missing family dart. A nimble elf named Connynque holds it and will try to take it back.

cast.name: Kolfinna
cast.who: keeper of a small west-forest orchard with a tidy public face and private worries.
cast.want: to have her stolen heirloom returned

cast.name: Connynque Duskbough
cast.who: a west-forest elf known for petty theft and hoarding small relics
cast.want: to keep the gull-feather dart and the map it opens

cast.name: Amitra
cast.who: a dusk-market vendor who trades jars and gossip to passing woodsfolk
cast.want: to be repaid with a jar of spiced pears

bible.situation: Kolfinna quietly believes her carved gull-feather dart was stolen and she hired the company to retrieve it without admitting loss to her neighbors. Connynque removed the dart and keeps it because the dart is a key to a hidden cache she guards. Amitra knows where the trail runs and will trade that knowledge for a jar of spiced pears.
bible.goal: to recover Kolfinna's stolen heirloom and return it to Kolfinna
arc: Search Kolfinna's orchard for signs of the theft Kolfinna described → yields: a gull-feather dart missing its shaft and a scrap of cloth stamped with Amitra's stall mark.
Visit Amitra at her dusk stall to ask about her mark, using the scrap from the orchard → yields: Amitra points toward Gull-Ledge and insists on a jar of spiced pears before she shows the way.

Follow Amitra's direction to Gull-Ledge and search the ledge's caves, using Amitra's guidance and the scrap of cloth → yields: a half-buried chest containing the dart and a torn sleeve bearing Connynque's stitch and a note saying she will try to reclaim the dart at Kolfinna's orchard.
Return to Kolfinna's orchard to hand the heirloom to Kolfinna while keeping her denial intact and face Connynque when she appears to take the dart
tensions: Connynque intends to come to the orchard and seize the dart back in front of witnesses
Amitra will not reveal Gull-Ledge without the spiced pears payment
Kolfinna insists the theft not be admitted publicly, limiting how the company can deal with the thief
openDirections: If the company keeps the hoard map or fails to hand it straight to Kolfinna, other seekers may learn of the hidden cache and press the fort.
bible.stakeIfLost: Kolfinna says that if the heirloom is not returned the orchard's old pledge will be broken and the grove's guardians will seize her land.
bible.arrival: crossed the river to get here · named a price before being asked

shipped.title: Search Kolfinna's orchard for theft signs
shipped.situation: A keeper of a small west-forest orchard, Kolfinna, crossed the river to the fort and named a price before being asked. She says the orchard's old pledge will be broken and the grove's guardians will seize her land if the heirloom is not returned. The task is to search Kolfinna's orchard for signs of the theft she described. A thief opposes this search and keeps the gull-feather dart and the map it opens. The coin comes at the finish, with the pick of what the job turns up. Kolfinna keeps her back to the wall while she watches you consider the work.
shipped.job: Find traces of the theft in Kolfinna's orchard.
